components.label: Realized volatility (20d, annualized)
components.detail: Std-dev of the last 20 daily returns × √252. The strongest single crash predictor in the test (t=5.4): the most volatile fifth of momentum names crashed 18.7% of the time vs 2.4% for the calmest fifth.

components.label: Distance above the 200-day SMA

components.label: Biggest one-day gain, last 21 sessions

components.label: 10-day run-up
components.detail: How hot the last two weeks were (t=3.4): the steepest fifth of recent legs crashed 14.3% of the time vs 5.1%.

exit_policy.rule: Exit on the first daily CLOSE below the 20-day EMA ($211.34) — from day 1, in addition to the stop.
exit_policy.evidence: On top of a normal stop, this exit cut fragile trades losing >10% from 5.2% to 3.5% and improved the median from −4.9% to −4.0%, costing ~0.3% of average return per trade (S&P 500, 2019–2026).

fragility.headline: Fragility 4/4 · EXTREME — 24.8% of similar strong-momentum setups fell ≥15% within 20 days (vs 8.6% on average, 2.9× the base).
fragility.action: Size capped at ⅓ and a 20-EMA close-exit from day 1 — fragility predicts how violent the next month is, not its direction.
fragility.basis: Point-in-time test on 498 S&P 500 stocks (2019-12 → 2026-09): cutoffs fit on 2019-12 → 2023-05, crash odds measured out of sample on 2023-06 → 2026-09 among strong-momentum setups (price > 50 > 200-SMA rising, ≤10% off the 52w high, 6m ≥ +25%, RSI ≥ 55). Crash = a ≥15% drawdown within 20 trading days. Current index members (survivorship-biased), no trading costs. Fragility predicts how violent the next month is, not its direction.

checks.label: Base / VCP contraction

checks.label: Bollinger squeeze
checks.detail: A Bollinger squeeze = volatility coiled at a multi-month low; expansion out of it fuels the momentum move.

checks.label: ATR contraction
checks.ideal: volatility drying up into the base
checks.detail: Falling ATR into a base = energy stored for the breakout; rising ATR = already moving/extended.

checks.label: MACD
checks.detail: MACD above zero AND its signal with a rising histogram = momentum accelerating.

checks.label: RSI (momentum)
checks.detail: RSI bearish divergence — price made a higher high but RSI didn't. Momentum fading; demand confirmation.

checks.label: Rate of change
checks.detail: Price rate-of-change confirms the thrust.

checks.label: Volume (dry-up → expansion)
checks.ideal: quiet base, surge on the break
checks.detail: Base 0.91× the prior run; today 0.78× the 20-day avg.

checks.label: OBV accumulation
checks.detail: On-balance volume rising = accumulation under the move.

checks.label: Distribution check
checks.detail: No high-volume selling climax recently.

checks.label: Demand below (stop base)
checks.ideal: a demand zone to stop under
checks.detail: Unmitigated bullish order blocks / fair-value gaps below = where buyers step in; the stop goes under them, not at a round number.

checks.label: Room to supply
checks.detail: Clear air (LVN vacuum / distance to the next supply) lets a breakout travel before hitting sellers.

setups.thesis: Momentum breakout — a leader (RS 28.4% vs SPY, +68% prior move) coiled in a 6-day base (15.9% deep) under $242.51. Buy the break of the $242.51 base pivot (refine with the 5-min opening-range high); stop under bull FVG $223.09; targets at real supply (then trail).
what_to_watch: FRAGILE 4/4 (24.8% crash odds vs 8.6% base): size capped at ⅓; EXIT on the first daily close below the 20-EMA $211.34 — from day 1, in addition to the stop.
Fresh breakout into a fragile tape: the better entry is a pullback to the rising 20-EMA or a new base. If you take this one, take it at the reduced size.
Confirm the break on a volume EXPANSION (base not especially quiet) — a break on light volume fails more often.
Trail: 10-EMA $220.09 (aggressive) / 20-EMA $211.34 (looser); exit on a daily close below the trail.
Invalidation: a close back inside the base (below $bull FVG $223.09) = failed breakout — take the stop, no averaging down.
